label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Cluster 0 is a differentiated squamous epithelial population, most likely cervical carcinoma or tumor epithelium, with weight on superficial and granular keratinization genes. M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23, CNFN), M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL, SCEL, EVPL) and M0 (KRT13, KRT4, CD24, PERP, DSC2) carry the lineage, and M28 adds TGM1, IVL and PI3. Basal markers (KRT5, KRT14) sit in other metagenes, so the cluster leans toward differentiated suprabasal cells. An S100A8/S100A9 inflammatory component (M0, M28, M70) is present at about 2 to 3% of counts and is treated as neighboring-cell or neutrophil background rather than a second lineage. The M20 glandular program (MUC1, CEACAM7, TMPRSS2) is also epithelial and does not change the call.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 3 and 30 (differentiated squamous epithelium); wording aligned to the shared form.

label: Low-quality cells (faint squamous signal)
description: Cluster 1 is dominated by technical and ambiguous metagenes: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 14.9%), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4 probe-like signal, 11.7%), and diffuse M45, M51, M61 and M56. Top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SAT1, ERO1A, SIGLEC15, GOLGA6L4) have no coherent lineage. The only identity signal is weak squamous-like expression: M37 (FLG, CRNN, IVL, KRT13; 1.6%, fold 2.5) and M10 (KRT15, ITGA2, DSC3; 1.5%), with KRT13 and TMPRSS2 in M51. Myeloid M14 (1.9%, 7.1% of cells) and p53/stress M54 (1.4%) are small, and the myeloid share is background. The cluster is probably low-quality with a faint squamous epithelial component, so the lineage call is tentative.

label: T cells (Treg-enriched, some CD8)
description: Cluster 2 is T lymphocytes. The T-lineage metagene M29 (CD3E, TRAC, CD3D, TRBC2, CD2, CD247, BCL11B) is present in 57% of cells, and the top genes are dominated by T-cell markers (TRAC, CD3E, TRBC2, CD3D, CD2, BCL11B). The regulatory T-cell metagene M83 (FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) has 40-fold enrichment and is present in 41% of cells, so the cluster leans toward Tregs. CD8 cytotoxic metagene M93 (CD8A, CST7, GZMK, PRF1) is present in about 24% of cells, a minority subpopulation. Stromal M75 and diffuse background metagenes are small and do not indicate contamination.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD8 T cells, T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, hypoxic)
description: Cluster 3 is a differentiated squamous epithelial population. The dominant metagene M37 (18.8% share, 56% of cells) carries cornification and granular-layer genes (FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13), supported by the terminal differentiation metagenes M15 (SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK10) and M69 (CRNN, KLK13, CNFN). Inflammatory S100A8/S100A9 (M0, M37) and hypoxia genes (M11: SLC2A1, NDRG1, ERO1A, CA9) add a qualifier. Basal markers KRT5 and TP63 are absent, so the cluster is superficial rather than basal. No listed metagene points to a foreign lineage as contamination.

label: Fibroblast ECM + smooth muscle stroma (low confidence)
description: Cluster 4 is a small, low-signal cell group. Its largest informative metagenes are stromal: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 4.1% share, fold 1.8x) and M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 4.0%, fold 2.6x), with M75 (stromal stress state, 2.3%) and top genes SFRP4 and CCN2 supporting a weak stromal identity. Most of the modeled counts come from diffuse housekeeping background (M64, M58, M43, M95; top genes GNAS, NPM1, PTMA, TPT1), and no lineage metagene is dominant, so the identity is uncertain. No clear contaminating lineage is present.

label: B cells (germinal center subset)
description: Cluster 5 is dominated by mature B cells: M34 (B cell markers) carries 16.5% of counts and is present in 80.8% of cells, with top genes MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22 and TNFRSF13C at high fold over other cells. M33 (germinal center B cells, CXCL13/CR2/GCSAM/AICDA) adds 6.4% of counts in about 13% of cells, suggesting a germinal-center subset within the B-cell population. Myeloid (M14) and stromal (M75) signals are small (2.0% and 1.9%) and not enriched, so no meaningful contamination is called. Ambiguous diffuse metagenes (M79, M8, M13) are background.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (S100A8/A9-high)
description: Squamous epithelial cluster. Several squamous metagenes carry most of the signal: M0 (differentiated squamous, 11.9%), M5 (KRT13/DSP-high squamous, 8.6%), M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia, 6.5%), M1 and M26 (basal keratinocyte genes KRT5, TP63, KRT15, ITGA6, ITGB4), and M18 (squamous differentiation). Top genes agree: PERP, KRT13, DSP, KRT5, SERPINB13, DSG3, DSC2, KLK10, CD24. The S100A8/S100A9 weight sits mainly in M0 and is probably part of the squamous program, not clear myeloid contamination, since no myeloid metagene is listed. The proliferation program M17 is small (2.5%), so this is not mainly a cycling cluster. Confidence is medium because the squamous signal is spread over many add-on metagenes and the basal/differentiated split is not sharp.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Cervical tumor cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high

label: Activated fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Cluster 7 is dominated by fibroblast/stromal signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM core, 18.5% share, in 70% of cells) and M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 13.8%) together with M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 6.1%) account for most counts, supported by top genes SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, CCN2, COL6A1, AEBP1, TAGLN, and GREM1. Smooth muscle contractile signal (DES, ACTG2, MYH11) is present in a subset, leaning toward a smooth muscle-like or activated stromal state. Epithelial, immune and endothelial lineages are not supported; the remaining diffuse metagenes (M56, M95, M60 and others) are low-usage background with no lineage.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte signal)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by endothelial identity: M27 (Endothelial cells, 22.2% of counts, present in 66% of cells) carries VWF, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR and MMRN1, and the top genes (VWF, EPAS1, COL4A1, PECAM1, APOLD1) match. M25 (pericyte-like, NOTCH3/RGS5, 18.1%, 72% of cells) is a strong co-occurring mural signal, consistent with vessel-associated pericytes, and fibroblast signal (M4, M38, M75) is small. Diffuse ambiguous factors contribute only a few percent each. The cluster is most likely endothelial cells in vessels, with a substantial pericyte/perivascular component.
contaminants: Pericyte/mural cells (M25, 18% share, present in most cells; likely vessel-associated, not foreign)

label: Low-quality cells (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 9 is dominated by technical and diffuse factors: M30 (OR4F17/IST1-high, 13.1% share, fold 18.3x) and M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4-high, 10.4%), with top genes OR4F17, IST1 and SMG1 that are probe or background-like. The only lineage signal is weak stromal: fibroblast M4 (3.2%, fold 1.4x), smooth muscle/myofibroblast M19 (2.6%, fold 1.7x) and endothelial M27 (1.3%, fold 2.2x), together about 7% of counts and present in only a minority of cells. Identity is therefore unclear and the cluster is probably low quality, with at most a faint stromal component.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells, Endothelial cells

label: Basal-like squamous epithelium + diffuse background
description: Cluster 10 has no clear identity. Its shares are spread across diffuse, nuclear/RNA-processing and artifact-like metagenes (M45 9.2%, M30 9.0%, M2 8.4%, M56 5.6%, M22 5.1%, M60 4.0%), and the top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SMG1, ZNG1A, SIGLEC15, ITCH) are non-lineage. The only epithelial signal is weak: M10 (KRT15/ITGA2/DSC3, 2.1%) and M74 (TP63/ITGB4/LAMB3/COL7A1, 3.7%), which lack core basal keratins (KRT5, KRT14, KRT17) and so suggest at most a basal-like squamous component. No contamination is supported by a listed lineage metagene.
cell_types: Basal-like squamous epithelial cells, Unassigned low-specificity cells

label: T cells (+ fibroblast/stromal signal)
description: Cluster leans toward T lymphocytes: M29 (T cell core, 3.3% share, in 28% of cells, fold 2.9x) is the strongest lineage metagene by cell coverage, supported by M83 (Treg, 2.3%) and M93 (CD8/cytotoxic, 1.8%). Top genes TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4 and CD52 agree. The largest shares are technical (M30, M2, M8), which say nothing about identity. Stromal signal is present at a moderate level: M4 fibroblast ECM (3.8%) and M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast (3.6%), with CCN2 and TAGLN among the top genes, about 9% of counts combined. This is probably spatial spillover or doublet-like contamination from neighboring stroma rather than a stromal population.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 T cells, regulatory T cells

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, noisy)
description: Cluster 12 is a small squamous epithelial population. Its lineage signal is modest (about 11% of counts) but consistent: M0 (differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high, 7.0%), M5 (squamous, DSP/KRT13-high, 3.1%) and M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, 1.3%, fold 2.5x), with IVL among the top genes. Much of the cluster is technical (M30 OR4F17/IST1 and M2 SIGLEC15/GOLGA families, about 22%) and it carries NF-kB/TNF inflammatory (M36, M35), hypoxia (M11) and IFN-gamma (M49) programs. No second lineage is clearly supported, so the identity is squamous epithelium, likely tumor-derived, with an inflamed, technically noisy profile.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxic, differentiated)
description: Squamous epithelial cluster, most likely cervical tumor epithelium. M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes, 25.3% share) leads, with SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2, NECTIN4 and CTNND1 among the top genes, and basal keratinocyte metagenes M26 (12.6%) and M80 (7.9%) add to the epithelial identity (KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, LAMB3). The hypoxia genes BHLHE40, SLC2A1 and NDRG1 suggest a state qualifier. Glandular metagene M20 (5%) and neutrophil-like S100A8/9 signal are small and likely spillover or background, so no contaminant is called.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Fibroblast cluster. M4 (fibroblast ECM, 11.5% share, 5.1x fold) is the main signal, and the top genes are fibroblast ECM genes (COL3A1, COL6A1/A2, COL5A1, SFRP1/SFRP4, LUM, TNC, DKK3). Activated/CAF-like ECM remodeling (M38, 2.5%) and smooth-muscle-like stroma (M19, 3.8%) add to it. Much of the counts are technical (M30 OR4F17/IST1 at 17.3%, M2 at 13.4%), which lowers confidence. Squamous (M37) and immune (M93 CD8, M3 IgG plasma) signals are minor and only in a few cells, so they are not treated as contamination.
refine_reason: Same activated ECM-remodeling fibroblast identity as cluster 33; wording aligned.

label: Fibroblasts (weak stromal signal)
description: Cluster 15 is a very small (36 cells) and weakly defined group. Its best-supported identity is fibroblasts: M4 (fibroblast ECM, 7.0% share, fold 3.1) is enriched, and top genes SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1 and COL6A1 agree. M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 3.2%) adds a weak stromal signal. Most of the cluster's counts go to diffuse housekeeping, ER-secretory (M77) and ambiguous nuclear factors, so the call is low confidence. Endothelial (M27, 4.0%) and Treg (M83, 4.2%) signals are small, under 5%, and treated as background rather than contamination.
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is a basal-like squamous epithelial population. Its epithelial metagenes carry about a third of counts: M1 (basal squamous, 9.1%), M26 (basal keratinocyte program, 6.1%), M10 (KRT15-high, 5.6%), M80 (TP63/COL17A1 basal state, 4.8%) and M5 (squamous, 2.8%). The top genes KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3, NFIB and CYP24A1 support this. Much of the remaining signal is diffuse ambiguous metagenes (M74, M45, M46, M22) with no clear lineage, and there is no clear foreign lineage, so no contamination is called. Cycling (M17, 3.1%) is a minor add-on in a subset of cells.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Squamous epithelial cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular epithelium/fibroblast mixture (doublet-like)
description: Small cluster (24 cells) with two comparable lineages. Glandular/secretory epithelial signal comes from M20 (6.2% share, in 33% of cells, fold 7.7x), with MUC1, CEACAM7, LYPD2, TMPRSS2 and PSCA among the top genes. Stromal signal is at least as strong: fibroblast ECM M4 (5.2%) and activated fibroblast M38 (3.7%), with COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1 and COL4A1 among the top genes. Neither lineage is clearly the cluster's own, so this is read as a doublet-like or spillover mixture. Squamous (M37), B-cell (M34) and endothelial (M27) shares are small and in few cells. OR4F17 and other diffuse metagenes are technical and do not inform identity.
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling squamous epithelial cells
description: Proliferative cluster with a squamous epithelial lineage. Cell-cycle programs dominate the share: histone/mitotic M7 (8.5%), S-phase M17 (7.3%), G1/S M24 (3.4%) and G2/M M39 (3.0%), and the top genes are H1-5, H3C2, TPX2, MKI67, TOP2A and BIRC5. The lineage comes from basal squamous M1 (6.0%, KRT5/TP63/DSP) and the squamous add-on M5 (3.3%, DSP/DSC3/KRT13), with TP63/ITGB4 support from M74 (3.2%). The lineage metagenes are diffuse and KRT14/SFN are weak, so the call is medium confidence. No meaningful foreign lineage: the NF-kB program M35 is 0.5%.
cell_types: Cycling squamous epithelial cells, Cervical squamous tumor cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells
description: Cluster 19 is a T-lymphocyte population, with the strongest signal from a regulatory T cell metagene (M83, 7.2% share, 6.4x fold, in 38% of cells) that carries FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS and TIGIT. Core T cell metagene M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, BCL11B) adds 3.3%, and the top genes are TRAC, CTLA4, CD3E, TRBC1, TRBC2 and LTB. A CD8 cytotoxic metagene (M93, 1.6%) suggests some CD8 or NK-like cells. Fibroblast (M4, 3%) and myeloid (M14, 2.2%) signals are small, background-level, and not treated as contamination. The OR4F17, IST1 and SIGLEC15 technical metagenes are ignored.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (myeloid)
description: Myeloid cluster, most likely tumor-associated macrophages. M14 (myeloid, CLEC10A/FCGR2A-high, 22.1% share, in 80% of cells) and M59 (TAM, 7.8% share, 38.8x fold) carry most of the signal. Top genes C1QA, C1QC, C1QB, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, STAB1, FCER1G and FGL2 are strongly enriched, supporting a macrophage identity. M14's dendritic-type genes (CLEC10A, CD1C) leave some monocyte/DC ambiguity. The basal squamous signal (M1, 1.8%, fold 0.6) is background and is not treated as contamination.

label: Fibroblasts (+ endothelial signal)
description: Cluster 21 is a small stromal cluster led by fibroblast ECM programs: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, 6.5%) and M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 5.1%), with M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma (3.3%) adding to the stromal signal. Top genes COL3A1, COL6A1, COL6A2, COL5A1, COL4A1 and SFRP4 support this. The IFN-gamma program M49 (8.7%; CXCL9, CXCL10, STAT1, GBP1, TAP1) is large but shared across lineages, so it qualifies the cluster rather than defining it. Endothelial M27 (6.0%, VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1) is best read as contamination from neighboring vessels, since its largest share is in cluster 8. CD8/NK cytotoxic M93 is present in only about 12% of cells at 3.7% share and is minor.
contaminants: Endothelial cells, CD8 cytotoxic T/NK cells
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, inflamed (+ macrophage background)
description: Cluster 22 is a very small cluster (36 cells) whose best-supported identity is differentiated squamous epithelium with an inflamed, hypoxic component. M37 (squamous differentiation, inflamed; fold 9.2x) carries 6% of counts, and the top genes include CRNN, ECM1, ERO1A and EMP1, with M0 (differentiated squamous, S100A8/9-high) as a related factor. Most counts sit in diffuse ambiguous factors (M45 at 26.8%, M64, M86, M84), so the call is weak. M59 tumor-associated macrophage signal (3.1%, fold 5.0x, in 8.3% of cells) is below the contamination threshold and is mentioned only as minor background, along with M17 proliferation (7.5%) and M38 activated fibroblast signal (2%).

label: Fibroblasts (+ macrophage signal)
description: Small, low-quality cluster dominated by diffuse background (M58 16.7%, M64 9.3%, plus several minor housekeeping factors). The most supported lineage is fibroblast: M4 (10.1%, fold 4.5x, COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1) with M38 activated-fibroblast ECM (2.2%). Foreign signal is a macrophage contribution, M59 (7.3%, fold 11.6x, C1QA, APOE, MMP9) that is concentrated in only about 2.5% of cells, so it is likely doublet or spillover. Smaller plasma (M3 2.1%, IGHG1) and T-cell (M29 3.8%) signals are present in few cells. Confidence is low because no lineage clearly dominates.
contaminants: Tumor-associated macrophages, IgG plasma cells, T cells

label: Fibroblasts
description: Cluster 24 is a small fibroblast population. The fibroblast ECM metagene M4 holds 11.2% of counts and is enriched fivefold, and the top genes are fibroblast and ECM genes (COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1, TNC, COL5A1, IGF1, DIO2). A cytotoxic CD8/NK metagene (M93, 5.4% share, in about 2.6% of cells, roughly one cell) and a T-cell metagene (M29, 4.2%) add a minor lymphoid signal, likely from a doublet or spillover. The rest is diffuse background metagenes with no lineage.

label: IgG plasma cells (ER stress high)
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by antibody-secreting plasma cells: M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, 14.1% share, in 54% of cells) and M31 (plasma cell immunoglobulin program, 5.8%) together with M23 (IgG plasma cell markers, 1.8%) carry IGHG1, IGHG2, IGHG3, IGKC, IGLC7, XBP1, MZB1, DERL3 and PRDM1, with B-cell markers MS4A1 and CD19 absent. The ER stress/UPR program M53 (24.9%, in 80% of cells) is a secretory-activity feature of these cells rather than a separate lineage. Fibroblast M4 (3.1%, fold 1.4x) is minor and mostly from cluster 33, so it is only background; no other lineage is substantial.

label: Fibroblasts / smooth muscle stroma (+ T cell doublets)
description: Stromal cluster of 35 cells. Its strongest signals are a smooth muscle/myofibroblast factor (M19, 13.9% share, DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, MYLK) and fibroblast ECM factors (M4, M38; COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP4, CCN2, GREM1). Top genes are mostly collagens, SFRP4, CCN2, TAGLN and THBS1, which fits a fibroblast/smooth muscle-like stroma, though the smooth muscle factor is carried by only about 2 cells. A T-cell factor (M29, 7.4%) sits in a small subset of cells, likely doublets or spillover, and is not the cluster's own identity.
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: Squamous epithelium, NF-kB/TNF-high (low confidence)
description: Cluster 27 is a small (50-cell) cluster dominated by the NF-kB/TNF response program M36 (12.3% of counts, fold 16.1x) with diffuse, low-specificity background factors. Its best lineage signal is squamous, from M37 (keratinization and inflamed superficial layer, 3.8%), M69 (CRNN-high differentiated squamous, 2.4%) and M5 (squamous, 2.9%), together about 9%. Top genes support this only weakly: CRNN is the 2nd gene at 4.5x, with ERO1A and SOD2 also present. T-cell lineage (M29 and M93, about 6% combined, mostly in few cells) and fibroblast metagenes (M38, M75, about 5%) are small and likely contamination or spillover from neighboring cells. Lineage is only weakly resolved, so confidence is low.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Mixed low-lineage cells

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Cluster 28 is a fibroblast population. M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, 41% of counts, 81.5% of cells) and M38 (activated, ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 21%, 33% of cells) carry the collagen, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC and PDGFRA genes that define the cluster, and the top genes COL3A1, COL6A1, COL5A1/2 and MMP11 agree. Foreign signal is small: plasma cell (M3, M31, about 4% combined, few cells), squamous/inflamed (M37, 4.5%) and myeloid (M59, 1.5%) are background, so no contaminant is called.

refine_reason: Same activated ECM-remodeling fibroblast identity as cluster 33; wording aligned.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ stromal signal)
description: Small cluster (29 cells) whose largest identity metagene is the squamous differentiation program M37 (6.7% share, 10.4x fold, top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, SCEL, KRT13), supported by M70 (squamous/mucosal differentiation genes). The top modeled genes agree: ERO1A, CRNN, FLG, CRCT1 and SCEL are enriched. Stromal signal is substantial but secondary: fibroblast ECM M4 (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1) and smooth muscle M19 (DES, TAGLN, MYH11) together reach about 11%, so this is likely contamination or stromal mixing. The cell-state qualifier is inflamed/hypoxic, with ERO1A and S100A8 present. Basal markers are absent, so this leans toward a superficial keratinizing layer rather than basal cells. Lineage evidence is moderate and no metagene is dominant.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Keratinizing squamous epithelium

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed, hypoxic)
description: Small cluster (32 cells) whose identity is differentiated squamous epithelium. The largest shares come from M37 (7.5%, cornification and granular-layer genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13, with inflammatory S100A8 and hypoxia ERO1A), M15 (2.3%, cornification genes IVL, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK7) and M6 and M0 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia or S100A8/A9 add-ons). The top genes ERO1A, IVL, CRNN, FLG and CRCT1 agree. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the cells look superficial or suprabasal. Fibroblast M4 (3.5%) and plasma-cell-like IGHG1 are small background, below the contamination threshold, so no contaminants are listed. Cycling M7 is minor.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (inflamed)
description: Small cluster of differentiated squamous epithelial cells with an inflamed, hypoxic profile. M37 (squamous differentiation, 12.4% share, 19x fold) and M15 (cornification genes) carry the signal, and the top genes are FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, IL36A and SCEL, with ERO1A and S100A8 as inflammatory/stress features. Basal keratins are absent, so the cells look superficial rather than basal. T-cell (M29, 7.2%, in 13% of cells) and fibroblast (M4, 6.2%, in 10% of cells) signal is moderate and present in a minority of cells, consistent with doublets or spillover; plasma cell signal (M3, 1.6%) is minor.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, superficial)
description: Cluster 32 is tiny (33 cells) and dominated by diffuse, low-specificity metagenes (M98, M57, M50, M58, M64 and others), so no lineage is clearly dominant. The most specific signal is the squamous differentiation metagene M37 (fold 9.5x, FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13) with neutrophil-like S100A8 and hypoxia/ER-stress genes (ERO1A). The top genes agree with this (FLG 9.5x, CRNN 2.7x, ERO1A 5.1x). It lacks basal markers (KRT5, KRT14), so it likely reflects superficial, inflamed keratinizing squamous cells. T-cell metagene M29 is present at 4.1% share (fold 3.7x) with no T-cell genes among the top genes, which is below the contamination threshold. The NF-kB program M35 is a minor add-on.

label: Activated fibroblasts (ECM-remodeling)
description: Cluster 33 is a fibroblast population: the core fibroblast ECM metagene M4 carries 42.3% of counts (18.9x fold, present in 92% of cells), and the top genes (COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, LUM, COL1A2, TNC, MMP2) all fit fibroblasts. M38 (activated/ECM-remodeling fibroblast state, 13.2%, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11) suggests a cancer-associated activated subset, and M19 adds a smooth-muscle-like stromal component (5.6%, DES, ACTG2, MYH11). No immune, epithelial or endothelial contamination is evident, and the remaining metagenes are diffuse background.

label: Fibroblasts (+ smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Small cluster of 39 cells dominated by fibroblast/stromal signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, 5.3% share, fold 2.4x) and M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts) with COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, SFRP1/SFRP4, CCN2, AEBP1 among top genes. Smooth muscle/perivascular stroma (M19, DES/ACTG2/MYH11) and pericyte-like (M25, NOTCH3/RGS5) factors add a vascular-smooth-muscle component, but the stromal ECM signal is the core identity. Most of the cluster's counts sit in diffuse ambiguous background factors (M64, M60, M45, M91, M97), with no clear lineage. Minor squamous differentiation signal (M37, 4.1%, in 7.7% of cells) is weak and likely spillover from neighboring tumor/epithelium, not the cluster's identity.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, low quality)
description: Cluster 35 is a small, low-signal cluster of 37 cells. Its clearest lineage signal is squamous differentiation (M37, 6.0% share, 9.2x fold), with cornification and granular-layer genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and KRT13 among the top genes, pointing to superficial keratinizing squamous epithelium, possibly inflamed or hypoxic (S100A8, ERO1A). Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent. A fibroblast ECM factor (M4, 4.4%) is weak and below the contamination threshold, so it is noted but not listed. Most of the counts are technical or diffuse (M30, M2, M58, M9, M73 and others), and the interferon program (M52, 2.4%) is a state rather than an identity. Confidence is low.

label: Squamous epithelium-like, weak signal (ambiguous)
description: Cluster of 39 cells with weak identity. The largest lineage signal is squamous epithelium: M6 (6.9%, squamous differentiation with hypoxia), M37 (3.6%, inflamed squamous differentiation with FLG/CRNN/IVL) and M5 (2.6%, squamous/desmosomal). Together these are about 13% of counts, but none of the top genes (OR4F17, GNAS, IST1, ERO1A, DAZAP2) is a lineage marker, and the squamous metagenes are present in only 5-10% of cells. Most counts come from diffuse background factors (M58, M64, M45, M30). Smooth muscle (M19, 3.3%) and CD8/NK (M93, 2.4%) are below the contamination threshold and are noted only as minor signal. Call is low confidence.

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-rich stroma, immune spillover)
description: Cluster 37 is a fibroblast/stromal cluster. The top genes agree: SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, COL6A1, CCN2, TNC, LUM, TAGLN and THBS1 are all enriched about 5x. Foreign signal is modest and spread over few cells: T cell (M29, 4.3%), myeloid/TAM (M14 3.6% and M59 3.5%), cytotoxic CD8/NK (M93, 1.6%), and squamous epithelium (M37 4.6% and M65 2.0%, with CRNN and CRCT1 among the top genes). These are contamination or spillover, not the cluster's identity.

label: Squamous epithelium/fibroblast mixture
description: Small, heterogeneous cluster with two comparable lineages. Squamous epithelial metagenes (M5 9.4%, M18 4.1%, M65 2.3%; KRT24, KRT5, KLK10 among top genes) total about 16% of counts, and stromal metagenes (M19 smooth muscle/myofibroblast 7.4%, M4 fibroblast ECM 5.6%; SFRP4, CCN2, COL3A1, TAGLN, SFRP1 among top genes) total about 13%. Neither lineage clearly dominates, so this is read as a mixture. Plasma (M3, IGHG1) and T-cell (M29) signals are small (1.4% and 2.7%) and are not called as contamination.

label: Cancer-associated fibroblasts (+ myeloid signal)
description: Small cluster (33 cells) whose identity rests on the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (11.9% share; COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1, SFRP1/4, TNC, PDGFRA) and the activated-fibroblast factor M38 (COL3A1, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11), which share the fibroblast core. Top genes are dominated by collagens and SFRP1/SFRP4, confirming a stromal identity. Diffuse background factors M58 and M64 (about 18% combined) are non-lineage. Myeloid M14 (7.3% share, in 3% of cells) suggests a minority of doublet-like cells carrying myeloid signal, which is noted as contamination.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (+ stromal and lymphoid signal)
description: Small cluster (50 cells) whose best-supported identity is squamous epithelium: M5 (squamous epithelium, DSP/KRT5/KRT13/PERP, 11.4%) and M37 (squamous differentiation with FLG, CRNN, IVL, KRT13, 4.8%) together give about 16% of counts, with KRT5 and FLG among the top genes. Stromal signal is modest: M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast, 6.1%) and M25 (pericyte-like, 2.4%), which together are under 10%, so this is contamination-level rather than a mixture. Immune signal is also small: M34 (B cell, 2.7%) and M93 (CD8/NK cytotoxic, 2.2%) are likely lymphoid aggregate or neighbor spillover. Most of the remaining counts are diffuse ambiguous, technical or program metagenes (M99, M30, M2, M94, M45, M86, M88, M49, M35) that do not define a lineage. The squamous identity is the best-supported call, but the cluster is small and the composition is spread out, so confidence is medium.

label: Fibroblasts (ECM-high, diffuse background)
description: Cluster 43 is a small fibroblast cluster. Foreign lineages (T cells M29, macrophages M59, squamous M37/M69) are each under 5%, so they are background and not listed as contaminants.

label: Activated stromal cells (IFN-gamma response)

Smaller immune signals are Treg markers (M83, 3.1%) and immunoglobulin genes IGHG3 and IGLC7, which hint at plasma cells but lack plasma-cell core genes. Most of the remaining signal is diffuse background, so the call is tentative.
